semiconductor_relevance: High — O-TEC specializes in providing used semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related services, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor equipment sector.
summary: O-TEC offers a comprehensive service for used semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including procurement, refurbishment, startup, and maintenance. Their expertise extends to high-pressure gas piping technology, which is critical for maintaining clean environments in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Refurbishment and maintenance of vacuum dryers and clean ovens
Chemical etching and stripping equipment support
Control systems for gas flow and humidity management
